title: Room for the Spark
caption: Atmospheric electronic rock, driven by a memorable gritty syncopated guitar riff with breathing space and brief dissonant turns. Tight electronic percussion beneath organic drums, ghost notes, occasional breakbeats and a warm textured bass. Evolving synth atmospheres answer the guitar. A warm mid-register English lead sings intimate yearning verses, sustaining phrase ends with natural vibrato, rising into controlled rasp at emotional peaks. Expansive melodic choruses with selective vocal doubles, a distinct higher harmony and occasional answers. Start spacious, build gradually, strip back for the bridge, then let the final chorus hit wider and harder. Deep stereo space, tactile textures and clear separation; keep the vocal and bass present beneath wide layered guitars.
lyrics:
[Atmospheric Intro]

[Verse 1]
The elevator stalls between floors
Your hand is inches from the door
A loose wire ticks behind the wall
We count the seconds till it falls
I had a speech for when you came
Now all I have is your first name

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't make it easy, don't make it clean
Let the beat stumble underneath me

[Chorus]
Leave a little room for the spark
Let it land where the wires are bare
I can hear your breath in the dark
Even over the weight of the air
If I say what I came here to say
Would you stay till the shaking stops?
Leave a little room for the spark
(A little room, a little room)

[Instrumental Break]

[Verse 2]
On the mezzanine the rail is cold
You rub a dent my keys put in the chrome
I used to take the stairs to feel the climb
Tonight I take them one at a time
You say the silence did its share
I hear you now, the words are there

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't make it easy, don't make it clean
Let the beat stumble underneath me

[Chorus]
Leave a little room for the spark
Let it land where the wires are bare
I can hear your breath in the dark
Even over the weight of the air
If I say what I came here to say
Would you stay till the shaking stops?
Leave a little room for the spark
(A little room, a little room)

[Spacious Bridge]
When the drums drop out, I hear it clear
I never said I wanted you here
Not because I didn't
Because I did

[Final Chorus]
Leave a little room for the spark
Let it land where the wires are bare
I can hear your breath in the dark
Even over the weight of the air
Now I've said what I came here to say
Will you stay till the shaking stops?
Leave a little room for the spark
(A little room, a little room)
Leave a little room for the spark

[Instrumental Outro]
